AUTHOR: Soom
TITLE: Open real-time, non-invasive fish detection and size estimation utilizing binocular camera system in a Portuguese river affected by hydropeaking
REGION: Avelames River (Bragado) and Couto River (Covas do Barroso), Tamega/Douro basin, Portugal
SPECIES: Northern Iberian chub (Squalius carolitertii), Northern straight-mouth nase (Pseudochondrostoma duriense), brown trout (Salmo trutta); detection appears single 'fish' class
DATA: PTFish: own binocular IR+RGB camera footage in flow refuges (EcoPeak4Fish), 18,523 annotated frames (18,292 Bragado, 231 Covas); week-long hydropeaking analysis 26 Apr-3 May 2023
V_EV: no statement found (only generic mention: 'Environmental factors such as low luminosity, low-contrast regions, air bubbles, turbidity... may further exacerbate these challenges.')
D2: 80/20 hold-out (14,818/3,705 frames); training portion repeatedly random sub-sampled into 5 train/test sets
D_EV: Fig. 1: 'the frames are selected at specific intervals to avoid having similar samples'; Sec 2.3.1: 'The dataset was split into separate datasets for training and validation using a ratio of 80:20.'
R_EV: Sec 3.1: evaluation 'performed using a hold-out validation dataset composed of 3705 frames' from the same PTFish dataset.
E_EV: Sec 2.5: 'Fish measuring less than 10 cm in length were categorized as juveniles... the number of juvenile and adult fish was counted and averaged per second of the video.'
ARCH: YOLOv8s (selected over YOLOv8n, YOLOv10n/s, RT-DETR-l, DEYO-N) + IR/RGB stereo matching, disparity depth and bounding-box size estimation
METR: Precision, recall, F1, mAP@.5, mAP@.5:.95; depth/size absolute & relative error (ArUco markers); FPS, power
NOTE: Size/depth estimation validated only against ArUco markers of known size at 25-46 cm (not fish); coded E5=없음 under lower-information rule - verifier may judge marker validation as independent physical reference (would make E_ALL=Y). E1 = size class (juvenile/adult) + counts per second over hydropeaking periods. Frame selection at intervals to avoid similar samples coded D3=Y; holdout described as ratio only, coded frame-random. Frames counted by time of day (incl. night, IR) but no illumination characterisation -> V3=NR. Processing rate 10 fps on Jetson; video frame rate not stated. Dataset on Zenodo.
